categories.main_business_segments: CJ Seafood Corporation primarily operates in the seafood processed food industry, producing and selling products such as fish cakes (eomuk), seaweed (gim), grilled fish, and tofu products. The company expanded its business through mergers and acquisitions, including acquiring 100% stake in Samhae Corporation, a dried seafood wholesale company, to strengthen production capabilities and scale. It focuses on both domestic and export markets with a strong emphasis on processed seafood products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced hygienic and quality control systems, including HACCP certification for all processed products, ensuring food safety and quality. Production involves processing raw materials like surimi (fish paste) and seaweed, with manufacturing facilities equipped for mass production and product innovation. CJ Seafood collaborates with CJ CheilJedang's central research institute for new product development and production efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CJ Seafood serves primarily domestic consumers through retail channels such as discount stores, chain stores, convenience stores, and agency networks, leveraging CJ CheilJedang's extensive sales network. It also caters to B2B customers including catering and institutional food service providers. Export markets include the United States, China, and Vietnam, focusing on seafood processed products like seaweed and fish cakes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with four domestic manufacturing sites located in Gyeonggi-do and Jeollabuk-do provinces. Its export activities extend to international markets including the US, China, and Vietnam. The company sources raw materials internationally, particularly surimi from China and Vietnam, and seaweed from domestic suppliers.
categories.supply_chain_position: CJ Seafood operates primarily in the midstream segment of the seafood supply chain, focusing on processing and manufacturing seafood products. It procures raw materials such as surimi and seaweed from upstream suppliers and delivers finished processed food products downstream to retailers, food service providers, and export customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product innovation aligned with consumer health trends and convenience, actively developing new seafood processed products. It collaborates with CJ CheilJedang's food research institute for R&D and invests in production efficiency and quality control enhancements. Strategic focus includes expanding the seaweed business and strengthening manufacturing competitiveness through acquisitions and facility investments.
categories.revenue_model: CJ Seafood generates revenue primarily through the sale of processed seafood products including fish cakes, seaweed, tofu, and grilled fish. Sales channels include B2C retail via CJ CheilJedang's distribution network, B2B institutional sales, and exports. The company operates on a product sales model with contracts such as a significant supply agreement with CJ CheilJedang.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, CJ Seafood positions itself as a leading seafood processed food company in Korea, maintaining industry leadership through product quality, hygiene standards, and innovation. Its strong partnership with CJ CheilJedang and acquisition of Samhae Corporation enhance its competitive positioning in the domestic and export markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, CJ Seafood reported total assets of approximately 168.2 billion KRW and revenues of 148.3 billion KRW, with a slight revenue decline of 2.9% from the previous year. Operating profit remained stable at around 4.1 billion KRW, though net profit decreased by about 40.2%. The company has shown steady growth in assets and capital, with increased liabilities reflecting expansion activities including acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CJ Seafood emphasizes safe, high-quality seafood processed products with rigorous hygiene and quality control systems certified by HACCP. It differentiates through continuous new product development tailored to consumer health and convenience trends, leveraging strong R&D collaboration with CJ CheilJedang. The company’s extensive distribution network and trusted brand reputation provide reliable and innovative seafood food solutions to consumers and institutional clients.
